summary: Everyday gadget mysteries and tangible tech curiosities like phone batteries, SIM cards, and UPI QR codes drove your highest view counts. In contrast, general domestic science facts like boiling milk or cutting onions and abstract cosmic 'What If' scenarios completely flopped. Moving forward, anchor every video to familiar technology or everyday modern objects that viewers interact with daily, while adding explicit engagement triggers to convert views into likes and subscribers.
do_more: Focus on everyday modern gadgets and utilities like smartphones, SIM cards, chargers, and UPI payments
Use high-stakes physical curiosity angles like what happens if hardware gets damaged or punctured
Ask a direct comment-triggering question in the final 3 seconds to convert passive viewers into active subscribers
Package explanations into snappy '3 Quick Facts' formats that maintain viewer retention
avoid: Avoid domestic kitchen science topics like milk boiling, onions, or microwave cooking
Avoid abstract cosmic 'What If' space topics like the moon or ozone layer disappearing
Avoid full Romanized Hinglish titles without clear Hindi Devanagari hooks
Avoid dry historical trivia like obscure origins of tech names unless tied to a massive current brand
hook_tips: Start with visual danger or sudden consequence in the first second: 'Agar aapke phone ki battery me galti se chhed ho jaye...'
Challenge a universal everyday habit instantly: 'Aap roz water bottle khareedte ho, par kya aapko pata hai...'
Highlight hidden everyday details people overlook: 'SIM card ka ek kona hamesha kyu kata hota hai?'
Deliver the hook within 2 seconds before showing any intro or branding
title_tips: Pair a relatable Hindi question with an English urgency tag like 'Shocking Reality #Shorts'
Use clear Devanagari script for the core question to appeal directly to Hindi-speaking viewers
Include high-CTR buzzwords like 'Asli Sach', 'Shocking Truth', or '3 Quick Facts'
Keep titles under 60 characters so the punchline is fully visible in the mobile Shorts feed
